questions.content:
Let A and B be two sets containing 2 elements and
4 elements respectively. The number of subsets of
A <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0.02ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.76ex" height="1.09ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -491 778 482" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mo"><use data-c="D7" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-D7"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> B having 3 or more elements is :
questions.explanation:
A B will have 2 4 = 8 elements.

The number of subsets having atleast 3 elements

= 8C3 + 8C4 + 8C5 + 8C6 + 8C7 + 8C8

= 28 – (8C0 + 8C1 + 8C2) = 256 – 1 – 8 – 28 = 219
